if(CONFIG_KEYLAB_LAYER_SIGNAL)
  zephyr_library()
  zephyr_library_sources(src/layer_signal.c)

  # ZMK adds its own headers with `target_include_directories(app PRIVATE include)`, so a module
  # does not inherit them and `#include <zmk/...>` fails. The application source directory is
  # zmk/app for every build that reaches this module.
  zephyr_library_include_directories(${APPLICATION_SOURCE_DIR}/include)

  # The layer table is generated by `pnpm build`, not written by hand, so the directory holding it
  # is passed in at build time (scripts/compile.sh points this at the mounted out/ directory).
  if(NOT DEFINED KEYLAB_LAYER_SIGNAL_INCLUDE_DIR)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
      "KEYLAB_LAYER_SIGNAL_INCLUDE_DIR is unset: the module needs the directory holding the "
      "generated layer-signal.h. Run `pnpm build`, then build with "
      "-DKEYLAB_LAYER_SIGNAL_INCLUDE_DIR=<path to out/>.")
  endif()
  zephyr_library_include_directories(${KEYLAB_LAYER_SIGNAL_INCLUDE_DIR})
endif()
